name: RC-B10-0102/2025 – After § 20 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text: 20a. Calls for the EU, Rwanda’s neighbouring countries and Rwanda’s main trading partners to put in place a trade embargo for all minerals, including processed minerals, exported from Rwanda, until the RDF and the rebel group supported by Rwanda have been definitively withdrawn from the territory of the DRC;
